title: The Mystery of the Coconut Tree
summary: Join Professor Owl and sing along to count coconuts and tropical jungle treasures from 1 to 20!

quiz.question: What did Professor Owl count in the sunny jungle song?

title: Mango's Fruit Basket Adventure
summary: Mango leaps through the treetops counting delicious jungle fruits by twos: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10!

quiz.question: When Mango counts by twos after 2 and 4, what comes next?

title: Leafy's Rainbow Camouflage
summary: Watch Leafy explore circles, squares, and triangles hiding in the magical jungle leaves!

quiz.question: Which shape has 3 sides and 3 corners in Leafy's song?

title: Bloop's Lilypad Leaps
summary: Bloop hops along the pond lilypads counting 3, 6, 9, 12 with joyful frog splash rhythms!

quiz.question: How many lilypad hops does Bloop take each time when counting by threes?

title: Professor Owl's Starry Sky Clock
summary: Professor Owl charts glowing constellation stars counting by tens all the way up to 100!

quiz.question: When Professor Owl counts by tens, what number comes after 10, 20, 30?
